_comment: Golden fixture for case 32709250080512 (BankAction_CompleteTrail.xlsx). Every figure below was verified empirically against the real source file via the live parser + analyzer (not hand-entered). Amounts asserted with toBeCloseTo(,2); counts asserted exactly. See memory: competitor-feature-golden-discrepancies.

feature3_disputedReconciliation.note: rawHopInclDup - dedupAdjustment + exit + hold + other == headline (203524.16). dedupAdjustment is 0: this case has NO exact-duplicate HOP leg. The ₹409.56 leg (src 110263475064 -> dst 702902010004986, UTR 563707902816, amount 1400) is a UNIQUE transaction and is fully counted; it shares (beneficiary,date,amount,UTR) with a distinct ₹18.64-disputed leg, so the old dedup key wrongly dropped it (see fix/disputed-reconciliation-409). The two ₹500 legs (UTR 292427997327) differ by timestamp and are kept as distinct.

feature4_lien.formula: lien = max(0, min(received - forwarded - onHold - exits, disputedInflow))
feature4_lien.note: The disputed-inflow cap reduces the no-cap naive (71463.12) to the headline 32375.01; the per-account audit columns reconstruct the total line-by-line. (Restoring the ₹409.56 hop into account 702902010004986 shifted its capped lien, moving the table total from the pre-fix 32767.45 to 32375.01.)

feature5_dayOfWeek.note: Dated (143) + Undated (11) == 154 deduped legs. Weekday is the IST calendar day of each leg. The restored ₹409.56 leg dates to 2025-09-28 18:32 UTC == 2025-09-29 IST (Monday), so Monday gains one ₹1400 leg.
